title: Prove stationary recurrence and accuracy for the genuine scalar unit-clock class
statement: OnN0 letpi_n=e^-1/n!,d0=0,d_n=(n+1)^-2 for n>=1,p_n=[(n+1)(n+2)^2]^-1,q_n=1-d_n-p_n. Reference balance pi_n p_n=pi_(n+1)d_(n+1) gives the Poisson law. Assume the ACTUAL process genuinely is a birth/death Markov event kernel on the SAME graph and EVERY row event satisfies the supplied power bounds. Apply them to up/down marks: A_eta^-2(n+1)^(-1-eta)(n+2)^(-4eta)<=pprime_n/dprime_(n+1)<=A_eta²(n+1)^(-1+eta)(n+2)^(4eta). For eta<1/5 the upper ratio<=A_eta²2^(4eta)(n+1)^(-1+5eta),so invariant weights have summable factorial-power tails and every fixed stationary moment exists. With independent UNIT Exp1 time per marked event,including self-events,the actual process is nonexplosive and positive recurrent,expected ALL firings throughT equalT,andN_t<=n0+Pois(T) pathwise. For eta<=1/10,setw0=pi0 andw_(n+1)/w_n=pprime_n/dprime_(n+1). Thenw_n=pi_n exp(s_n),|s_n|<=eta R(n),R(n)=7n+5log(n!). DefineM_j=sum pi_n(n+1)^j andK_j=sum pi_n(n+1)^jR(n)exp[R(n)/10],j FIXED integer>=0. These constants are finite and COMPUTABLE:pi_nexp[R/10]=e^-1 exp(7n/10)/sqrt(n!),and the majorant(n+1)^j(7n+5n²)3^n/sqrt(n!) has successive ratio<=9(3/2)^j/sqrt(n+1). Cutoff n+1>=[18(3/2)^j]^2 makes its tail geometric with ratio<=1/2. Finite prefix plus certified tail needs no stationary-law,normalizer or exact-real oracle. Weighted unnormalized variation<=eta K_j; ifeta<=min(1/10,1/(2K0)),Zprime>=1/2 andsum(n+1)^j|pi_prime_n-pi_n|<=2eta(K_j+K0M_j). Thus stationary whole-TV and EVERY FIXED absolute moment have explicit O(eta) accuracy. The old additive-row counterexample eventually violates the power condition. This is a COMPLETE positive SCALAR/unit-clock theorem,not a claim that arbitrary decoded elementary networks are Markov,birth/death,reversible or constant-clock. General hidden-state occupation/recurrence/stationary full-cost transfer remains OPEN.
